title: Be a child honest about your mistakes
summary: Mercy makes room for honest error and deeper childlike trust. Lean where you are already being held.
takeaway: Lean where you are already being held.
lifeApplication: When the urge to hold yourself up alone returns, say the line like a child asking to be kept and let one breath soften.

source.shortMeaning: Mercy makes room for honest error and deeper childlike trust.
source.lifeApplication: After the mistake, stay in the Father's care long enough to tell the truth.

evidence.turn: Hold onto this: bring the truth about failure into the Lord's mercy.
